meta.title: SunmoonAI Admin
meta.description: A production Next.js administration foundation paired with a dedicated FastAPI Admin Backend.

public.title: A secure and auditable governance console foundation
public.description: Identity, authorization, session, data access and release boundaries are governed by explicit contracts.

errors.notFoundDescription: The requested page does not exist or is no longer available.
errors.forbiddenDescription: Your authenticated role does not allow this administration capability.

auth.logoutFailed: Sign out failed. Please try again.
auth.loginSubtitle: Authentication and session state belong to the paired FastAPI Admin Backend.
auth.loginCasdoorHint: The browser never stores provider tokens; authorization is converted into a backend-owned session.
auth.continueToDashboard: Already signed in? Open the governance console
auth.errorAuthFailed: Sign-in failed. Verify the Casdoor Admin application, callback URL and backend logs.
auth.errorNoCode: No authorization code was returned. Start sign-in again.
auth.errorOAuthGeneric: Authorization was denied or cancelled. Please try again.
auth.signupSuccessHint: Sign-up succeeded. Sign in to enter this site.

nav.governanceDescription: P0-007E will add navigation, authorization, CRUD, audit and shared tooling on this foundation.

knowbots.noPermission: This account has no admin rights (the admin or operator role is required). Sign out and sign in with an administrator account.

q.steps: What are the steps, and which rule decides each step?
q.outputs: What does the output look like?
q.correctness: How do you know it is right?

knowbots.noDatasets: This user has not uploaded any data.

questions.title: Questions to answer
questions.intro: The test stopped where a person has to decide; it continues once answered. We answer approvals; questions and ask-before prompts go to the user first (C-L1). If one is only about how to run, say why in one line and answer it ourselves; our answers are not the user's confirmation and are not written back to the cases or the rule sources.
questions.withUser: With the user, waiting for an answer.
questions.judgementHint: Anything that is an investment judgement (basis, trade-off, threshold) goes back to the user.
questions.takeReason: Why this is only about how to run (one line)

knowbots.answeredTitle: Questions answered during tests (only the user's go into the next draft's rule sources)
knowbots.adminOnly: Only an admin can do this (create drafts, review rule sources, deliver, return). Operators can view, start tests and answer how-to-run questions.

next.testing: Testing: press “Refresh result” now and then
next.failed: Did not pass: read the result and outputs above, fix the manifest and hatch the next avatar
next.passed: Passed, but delivery failed: retry delivery
next.revise: New revision: hatch the next avatar
next.superseded: A newer avatar was hatched after this one; this is history

knowbots.reviewHint: Every rule must match the user’s own words (C-L1). Read them all before confirming.
knowbots.startHint: The budget is split evenly across cases; the timeout is shared by all cases of the run and excludes time spent waiting for answers.
knowbots.acceptedWaiting: Accepted, not started yet: waiting for the test computer
knowbots.submittedAt: Submitted {at}; press “Refresh result” to see whether it started
knowbots.testingHint: After a refresh the line above says which case and step it is on; a case shows up in the result below only when it has finished.
knowbots.bindingsHint: Write the manifest’s data_bindings like this:
knowbots.noAnswered: No questions answered during tests yet.
knowbots.noAmendments: The user has not written any amendment.
knowbots.queuedLine: {case} (case {done}/{total}) is queued behind an earlier task of the test account

amendments.title: Amendments the user wrote: cite each one in the next avatar's rule sources (ref as shown below), or decline it with a reason.
amendments.reason: Why it is not followed (the user sees this)

knowbots.reviewBlocked: Handle these amendments first: cite them in this avatar's rule sources, or decline them with a reason (tab “Amendments”).
knowbots.newerAmendments: The user wrote {n} more amendments after this avatar was hatched; they go into the next avatar.

ideas.title: Ideas
ideas.intro: The method, acceptance cases and data a user handed in, plus any amendments written later. Handle amendments (cite or decline) and see which avatars were hatched from it; hatching happens on the Avatars page. The method comes only from the user (C-L1).

avatars.title: Avatars
avatars.intro: What was hatched from an idea to be tested. Each avatar goes through four stages on this page: hatch, check sources, test, deliver. After a test, read each case's write-up and step outputs to verify it.

experts.title: Experts
experts.intro: Versions that passed and were delivered to knowmart; retry here when delivery failed.

knowbots.noAvatars: No avatars yet. Pick an idea, or press “Hatch an avatar”.

ideaNext.amend: Next: handle the user's amendments (cite them in the next avatar, or decline them)
ideaNext.hatch: Next: hatch an avatar from this idea
ideaNext.waiting: A test question is with the user; waiting for the answer
ideaNext.working: An avatar is under test: see the Avatars page
ideaNext.expert: Has an expert; hatch the next avatar to revise it

hatch.forIdea: Hatch an avatar from this idea
hatch.title: Hatch
hatch.manual: Manual hatching: paste the expert manifest
hatch.hint: Only manual hatching exists for now: the manifest is written elsewhere, pasted here, checked and hatched. Assisted and automatic hatching, the source table, gaps with the user's answers and manifest candidates will go into this block later.

side.resize: Drag to resize (arrow keys work too)

outputs.title: Write-ups and step outputs
outputs.none: This test brought back no outputs.
outputs.truncated: The write-up is long; only the first part is shown.
outputs.omitted: Output too large to bring back ({bytes} bytes)
outputs.rejectedNoCheck: The reply was not valid JSON, so no check ran.
outputs.notYet: Not fetched yet: press “Fetch outputs again”.
outputs.consentNeeded: This idea was submitted under the old test-data notice: outputs are neither fetched nor shown until the user accepts the new notice on the web.
